title: News article
description: One self-contained article, both language versions in a single file. Written by the grok automation; consumed natively by the radio app's news section. See GROK.md and TIDINESS.md.

id.description: Stable, unique. Format: YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>. Never reused, never changed after publish.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 with Hong Kong offset (+08:00). Set once at first publish.

updated_at.description: Set ONLY when correcting an already-published article. ISO-8601 +08:00.

category.description: Single topical category from the controlled vocabulary.

tags.description: 0-6 lowercase topical tags for filtering. Not a substitute for category.

breaking.description: True only for genuinely urgent, high-impact stories the app should badge. Default false. Use sparingly.

ai_generated.description: Always true. Drives the app's mandatory 'AI-generated' disclosure.

story_key.description: Normalized identity of the underlying EVENT (not the headline wording), used for dedup against ledger.json. Same event across runs => same key.

headline.description: One line. <= 90 chars. No trailing punctuation, no ALL CAPS, no clickbait.

dek.description: One-sentence standfirst/summary line shown under the headline in list + detail.

body.description: Ordered paragraphs. Each item is one plain-text paragraph (no markdown, no HTML, no external links). App inserts native ads between paragraphs, so 3+ paragraphs is ideal.
